allowed: predictive bookkeeping has measurable/bounded wall-time overhead
expert-memory traffic is present at budget X
A/B real-runtime retention trajectories are equivalent
traffic and timing vary across budgets
not_allowed: policy overhead caused the R2 result

MECHANISM_OBSERVABLE: sham vs B_selected retention trajectories identical at all three budgets
expert traffic measured and > 0 at at least one tested budget
sham overhead satisfies the frozen precision criterion at 4 GiB
all frozen identities and acquisition invariants hold
classification.otherwise: MECHANISM_INSUFFICIENT, reporting the exact failing condition(s)

delta_overhead_cpu.formula: median over paired repetitions of cpu_per_token(B) - cpu_per_token(A)

delta_overhead_time.formula: median over paired repetitions of step_time(B) - step_time(A)

precision.criterion: 95% CI half-width of delta_overhead_time <= 0.01 * median step_time(A) at the 4 GiB budget
precision.name: OVERHEAD_BOUNDED

requires: at least one prospective runtime-cost quantity that is available before a retention decision or derivable from historical data
not derived from reserved holdout data, not based on TRACE_COUNT timing, not an unidentified causal claim
measurable or calibratable under the real runtime

primary_contrast: A (b_selected) vs B (predicted_protect_sham), paired within budget

questions.Q1: isolated runtime cost of predictive bookkeeping when retention is held equivalent to B_selected
questions.Q2: expert-memory traffic at 1.5 / 4 / 8 GiB under the real runtime
questions.Q3: budgets with enough measured traffic and runtime signal to justify a later cost-aware hypothesis
questions.Q4: can real TRACE_COUNT+TIMING CELL records be generated under the frozen R3-00A/R3-01 contracts
questions.Q5: does the sham remain behaviourally equivalent to B_selected through the real model/store path

scope: mechanism attribution only; not a cost-aware policy evaluation and not a policy success/failure
secondary_control: C (predicted_protect) at 8 GiB only, as a predictive-policy mechanism reference; not an overhead control

compared: requested expert sequence where semantically required
sham_equivalence_rule.on_failure: MECHANISM_INSUFFICIENT and A-vs-B timing is not interpreted as isolated overhead
